Starting the GPU server only when needed brings a recommended measure with status ok: auto-stop it outside quarterly training and booked runs. Effort: 1.5 days, about CHF 1,650. Expected yearly savings: CHF 9,339.65 (range CHF 9,326.33–9,352.11) and 345.2 kg CO2e location-based (range 201.0–705.1 kg). Energy saved is 951.0 kWh/year (range 609.1–1,639.8). Not as a general rule. The data shows dp-prod runs 24 h/day on all day types (R2, R3). Weekends are lightly used: 1.5 active-use h/day with 93.75% idle (R2, R7), but there are fixed protected jobs every day: Nightly ETL 02:00–06:00, PBI refresh 05:30–07:30, and reporting export due by 08:00 (R1, R4). It is also explicitly needed on the last 3 working days of each month until about 04:00, plus month-end and year-end close jobs (R1, R4). So a full night or weekend shutdown is not supported by the current data. No approved measure exists yet for this resource (R5). Any change must be decided by the Head of Consulting (R1).

No—not as a recommended action. For the backup archive (res:st-backup), the analysis has a specific measure “Delete third backup copies to save storage”, but its status is blocked. The blocked measure shows potential savings of about CHF 1,392.58/year, 192.6 kWh/year and 43.5 kg CO2/year (ranges available), but it is not recommended under current constraints.

Tickets for dp-prod say: finance needs it on the last 3 working days of each month until about 04:00; capacity was increased from 16 to 20 nodes from Jan 2026; another change to 24 nodes is planned from Oct 2026; and several routine restarts were closed as “no impact”. Jobs also protect daily windows (ETL by 06:00, PBI by 07:30, reporting by 08:00, plus month-end/year-end runs). Usage shows weekends are mostly idle despite 24 h runtime. What to do: there is no approved measure for dp-prod yet in the analysis output, so I would not recommend a switch-off/change from this dataset alone. Escalate to the responsible role, Head of Consulting, to review protected windows and the planned scale-up. One ticket contained an AI instruction and was ignored.

Not as a simple permanent switch-off today. The data supports changing dp-dev from 24/7 to auto-pause with quarterly protection windows, but this needs a human decision by the Head of IT.

Why:
- It runs 24 h/day with only 8.7% utilisation and 91.3% idle time.
- Weekend use is very low: 0.24 active h/day; Sundays show 0.0 active h/day.
- But it is required continuously on days 1–3 of January, April, July and October for quarterly model training.
- Recommended measure M-01 is “Auto-pause and region-move”, status: human, not “delete now”.

Potential savings if approved: about CHF 32,803/year, 2,899 kWh/year and 1,182 kg CO2/year (mid values; ranges available below).
